description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

KAYAK is a leading travel search engine within Booking Holdings that helps people find flights, stays, rental cars, and vacation packages. The Software Engineer, Ads (Backend) will design, build, operate, and support backend features and systems for advertising-related solutions, collaborating with product, commercial, engineering, data science, and business intelligence teams.
Backend software engineer building advertising systems and supporting production services

Responsibilities:
• Design and build backend features, from scoping through deployment and ongoing production support, with guidance from senior engineers and tech leads on more complex or ambiguous problems
• Take part in technical design reviews and architecture discussions, asking good questions and contributing ideas
• Write well-tested, readable, and maintainable code consistent with team quality standards; participate actively in code reviews, both giving and receiving feedback
• Work with product managers and commercial partners to understand requirements and deliver reliable outcomes
• Participate in on-call rotations: monitor system health, investigate production issues, and write clear bug tickets and documentation
• Look for opportunities to improve system performance, reduce complexity, and pay down technical debt in aging codebases
• Take part in sprint ceremonies — planning, refinement, retrospectives, and demos — and contribute ideas for improving team delivery
• Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly to improve productivity, code quality, and delivery efficiency
• Collaborate with engineers, data scientists, and business intelligence teams to deliver integrated solutions
• Grow your skills through mentorship, pairing, and feedback from more senior engineers

Requirements:
• Experience designing, building, and operating backend systems, gained through professional roles, internships, or substantial personal or academic projects
• Working proficiency in Java or a comparable backend language
• A foundational understanding of system design and debugging, and comfort working in distributed or multi-service environments
• A collaborative working style: you communicate clearly, follow through on commitments, surface risks early, and ask good questions
• Professional proficiency in written and spoken English
• Curiosity and a willingness to learn new tools, systems, and approaches, and to challenge existing approaches with well-reasoned alternatives
• A specific degree is not required

Preferred:
• Familiarity with ad tech systems, bidding logic, or monetization infrastructure
• Experience with server-to-server data integrations or event-driven architectures
• Experience working in an agile team environment with sprint-based delivery
• Exposure to observability tooling, metrics, or production debugging workflows
